friendly_name: Deliver Loaded Doctrine to the Agent
purpose_context: Two delivery pipelines carry governance to a dispatched agent — the action-doctrine bundle and the profile channel — and each drops content silently: glossary packs are structurally unreachable, procedure step bodies render only their title, project-overlay agent profiles are dropped by the builder, and context --json omits the procedures the text render ships. This mission makes loaded doctrine actually arrive (or ratifies a document-only path with a stated reason), while respecting the token budget that made several kinds pointer-only by design.
purpose_tldr: Close the silent no-ops where authored doctrine loads and validates clean but never reaches the dispatched agent.
